Name: JojaFizzy Energy Drinks
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Really Fuel Your Life with [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaFizzy[/b][/color]![/quote][/size]
JojaMart’s farthest right aisle stocks [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaFizzy[/b][/color]™ Energy Drinks! 
[b]
The aisle on the right side of the store is now a shop!
[/b]
• [b]6 [color=#6d9eeb]JojaFizzy [/color][/b]Energy Drinks with buffs, [b]+4 that cycle depending on the season[/b].
﻿- A decent energy boost at a low cost. [b]No Health restoring though![/b]
﻿- Cheap way to get some early game buffs, although short lived
﻿- Unlike other JojaBrands, these are more combat oriented
﻿- Since they're [b]drinks[/b], they'll also [b]stack [/b]with[b] food buffs

• [b]2 [/b]Decorative [/b]cases of [b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaFizzy[/color][/b]

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners[/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove/relocate the right aisle of the store.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI)
